python3 -c "
import json,re
b = json.load(open('../exp/runs/dev/bbc/bundle.json'))
for p in b['pages']:
    if p['url'] in ('https://www.bbc.co.uk/contact','https://www.bbc.co.uk/'):
        text = p.get('text_full') or p.get('text_extracted') or ''
        print(p['url'], len(text))
        # find phone-like patterns
        for m in re.finditer(r'(\+?\d[\d \-()]{7,}\d)', text):
            print('  phone-like:', m.group())
"
